description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5340015621677 BRACKET,DOUBLE ANGL: Line 0001 Qty 12 UI PG Deliver To: By: 0060 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
